# Identity secrets engine - TPM (API)

A TPM (Trusted Platform Module) record in Vault's identity store represents a
physical or virtual TPM device identified by its Endorsement Key (EK) public
key. TPM records allow Vault to track and control access for specific TPM
devices.

Key characteristics of TPM records:

- The **ID** is automatically derived as the SHA-256 hash of the decoded bytes
  from the `tpm_ek_public_key` field and cannot be changed after creation.
- The `tpm_ek_public_key` field is **immutable** — it can only be set at
  creation time.
- TPM IDs are scoped to a namespace, so the same EK public key may be
  registered in multiple namespaces without conflict.
- A **disabled** TPM cannot be used for authentication or certificate
  generation.

## Create a TPM

This endpoint creates a new TPM record. The `tpm_ek_public_key` field is
required and must be a PEM-encoded public key with the `PUBLIC KEY` header.

If a `name` is not provided, Vault generates a default name in the format
`tpm_<random-hex>`.

| Method | Path             |
| :----- | :--------------- |
| `POST` | `/identity/tpm`  |

### Parameters

- `name` `(string: "tpm-<random-hex>")` – A human-friendly name for the TPM
  record. Must be unique within the namespace. Can be updated after creation
  using the update endpoints.

- `tpm_ek_public_key` `(string: <required>)` – PEM-encoded TPM Endorsement Key
  (EK) public key. Must be a valid PEM block with type `PUBLIC KEY`. This value
  is **immutable** — it cannot be changed after the TPM record is created.

- `metadata` `(key-value-map: {})` – Metadata to be associated with the TPM
  record. In the CLI, this parameter can be repeated multiple times and all
  values are merged together.

- `disabled` `(bool: false)` – Whether the TPM is disabled. A disabled TPM
  cannot generate certificates or be used for authentication.

### Sample payload

```json
{
  "name": "my-tpm",
  "tpm_ek_public_key": "-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----\nMIIBIjANBgkq...\n-----END PUBLIC KEY-----\n",
  "metadata": {
    "machine_name": "server-01",
    "location": "datacenter-east"
  },
  "disabled": false
}
```

### Sample request

```shell-session
$ curl \
    --header "X-Vault-Token: ..." \
    --request POST \
    --data @payload.json \
    http://127.0.0.1:8200/v1/identity/tpm
```

### Sample response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "disabled": false,
    "id": "sha256-a3f1c2d4e5b6...",
    "metadata": {
      "location": "datacenter-east",
      "machine_name": "server-01"
    },
    "name": "my-tpm",
    "tpm_ek_public_key": "-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----\nMIIBIjANBgkq...\n-----END PUBLIC KEY-----\n"
  }
}
```

## Read TPM by ID

This endpoint queries a TPM record by its identifier.

| Method | Path                    |
| :----- | :---------------------- |
| `GET`  | `/identity/tpm/id/:id`  |

### Parameters

- `id` `(string: <required>)` – Identifier of the TPM record.

### Sample request

```shell-session
$ curl \
    --header "X-Vault-Token: ..." \
    http://127.0.0.1:8200/v1/identity/tpm/id/sha256-a3f1c2d4e5b6...
```

### Sample response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "disabled": false,
    "id": "sha256-a3f1c2d4e5b6...",
    "metadata": {
      "location": "datacenter-east",
      "machine_name": "server-01"
    },
    "name": "my-tpm",
    "tpm_ek_public_key": "-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----\nMIIBIjANBgkq...\n-----END PUBLIC KEY-----\n"
  }
}
```

## Update TPM by ID

This endpoint updates an existing TPM record by its identifier.

The `tpm_ek_public_key` field cannot be changed. Supplying a value that differs
from the existing key returns an error.

| Method | Path                    |
| :----- | :---------------------- |
| `POST` | `/identity/tpm/id/:id`  |

### Parameters

- `id` `(string: <required>)` – Identifier of the TPM record.

- `name` `(string: <optional>)` – Updated name for the TPM record. Must be
  unique within the namespace.

- `metadata` `(key-value-map: {})` – Updated metadata. Replaces the existing
  metadata entirely.

- `disabled` `(bool: false)` – Whether the TPM is disabled.

### Sample payload

```json
{
  "name": "renamed-tpm",
  "metadata": {
    "machine_name": "server-01-updated"
  },
  "disabled": true
}
```

### Sample request

```shell-session
$ curl \
    --header "X-Vault-Token: ..." \
    --request POST \
    --data @payload.json \
    http://127.0.0.1:8200/v1/identity/tpm/id/sha256-a3f1c2d4e5b6...
```

### Sample response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "disabled": true,
    "id": "sha256-a3f1c2d4e5b6...",
    "metadata": {
      "machine_name": "server-01-updated"
    },
    "name": "renamed-tpm",
    "tpm_ek_public_key": "-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----\nMIIBIjANBgkq...\n-----END PUBLIC KEY-----\n"
  }
}
```

## Delete TPM by ID

This endpoint deletes a TPM record by its identifier. Deleting a record that
does not exist is idempotent and returns no error.

| Method   | Path                    |
| :------- | :---------------------- |
| `DELETE` | `/identity/tpm/id/:id`  |

### Parameters

- `id` `(string: <required>)` – Identifier of the TPM record.

### Sample request

```shell-session
$ curl \
    --header "X-Vault-Token: ..." \
    --request DELETE \
    http://127.0.0.1:8200/v1/identity/tpm/id/sha256-a3f1c2d4e5b6...
```

## List TPMs by ID

This endpoint returns a list of all TPM record identifiers in the current
namespace.

| Method | Path                          |
| :----- | :---------------------------- |
| `LIST` | `/identity/tpm/id`            |
| `GET`  | `/identity/tpm/id?list=true`  |

### Sample request

```shell-session
$ curl \
    --header "X-Vault-Token: ..." \
    --request LIST \
    http://127.0.0.1:8200/v1/identity/tpm/id
```

### Sample response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "keys": [
      "sha256-a3f1c2d4e5b6...",
      "7d8e9f0a1b2c..."
    ]
  }
}
```

## Create/Update TPM by name

This endpoint creates or updates a TPM record by name. If no TPM with the
given name exists, a new record is created (and `tpm_ek_public_key` is
required). If a record with that name already exists, it is updated.

| Method | Path                        |
| :----- | :-------------------------- |
| `POST` | `/identity/tpm/name/:name`  |

### Parameters

- `name` `(string: <required>)` – Name of the TPM record.

- `tpm_ek_public_key` `(string: <required on create>)` – PEM-encoded TPM
  Endorsement Key public key. Required when creating a new record. Cannot be
  changed on an existing record.

- `metadata` `(key-value-map: {})` – Metadata to be associated with the TPM
  record. Replaces the existing metadata entirely on update.

- `disabled` `(bool: false)` – Whether the TPM is disabled.

### Sample payload

```json
{
  "tpm_ek_public_key": "-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----\nMIIBIjANBgkq...\n-----END PUBLIC KEY-----\n",
  "metadata": {
    "machine_name": "server-02"
  }
}
```

### Sample request

```shell-session
$ curl \
    --header "X-Vault-Token: ..." \
    --request POST \
    --data @payload.json \
    http://127.0.0.1:8200/v1/identity/tpm/name/my-tpm
```

### Sample response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "disabled": false,
    "id": "sha256-a3f1c2d4e5b6...",
    "metadata": {
      "machine_name": "server-02"
    },
    "name": "my-tpm",
    "tpm_ek_public_key": "-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----\nMIIBIjANBgkq...\n-----END PUBLIC KEY-----\n"
  }
}
```
